text:
Hello,

On 10 June 2026 my boss at Hagenbuch Management Ltd, Mark Schneider, gave me notice. He called me into his office in Winterthur, handed me the letter and said the company was 'restructuring the back office'. My colleague Olivia Egli was told nothing of the kind, and she is still there.

I'm pregnant and our baby is due at the end of October.

The important thing is that the pregnancy didn't start after the letter. I was already pregnant on 10 June, well into my fourth month, and I had told Mr Schneider about it on 20 May. So he knew perfectly well when he gave me notice.

There is also something about the notice he is ignoring. My written contract says that both sides have to give four months' notice to the end of a month. That's what we agreed, and it's longer than the law's normal periods. Mr Schneider's letter just mentions 'the usual notice', and HR told me on the phone that I'd be finished in a few weeks.

I'm attaching a confirmation from my midwife's practice.

I earn CHF 2,170 a month and I am really scared about the timing, with the baby coming. Could you tell me whether this notice is valid at all, and what I can do?

Thank you very much,
Ben Bieri
Birkenweg 123, Winterthur
